id: title:hpouillot:upload symbol sets with a presigned put when the server offers one

review.posthog_relevance: Adds presigned PUT URL support to S3-compatible object storage backends, enabling exact-content-length uploads for stores lacking presigned POST support (e.g., Cloudflare R2). This improves compatibility and reliability for PostHog's warehouse ingestion and error tracking symbol set uploads.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates implementation of presigned PUT URL generation and consumption, including the backend presigned PUT implementation, the object storage client, and the API interface and Zod schema. observations.behavior: Adds PresignedPutPair dataclass and get_presigned_put_pair() to support presigned PUT, including optional content-length and fallback to standard endpoint.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides presigned PUT URLs for S3-compatible stores that support PUT but not POST, such as Cloudflare R2, while retaining fallback to accelerated or standard endpoints.

observations.behavior: Implements presigned PUT URL generation, including optional content-length and fallback, with exception handling and capture_exception.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows presigned PUT to fail gracefully and report errors while still returning a fallback standard-endpoint PUT URL.

observations.behavior: Adds optional content_length field to ErrorTrackingSymbolSetUploadApi interface.
observations.code_quote: * Optional byte count of the content about to be uploaded. When given, the upload response also carries a presigned PUT signed for exactly this length, which S3-compatible stores without presigned POST support (such as Cloudflare R2) accept.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds a request parameter for byte count, potentially supporting S3-compatible stores lacking presigned POST support.
